name: mlab4195 Baseball Scoreboard
author: mlab4195

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to easily create and embed responsive baseball and softball scoreboards into your WordPress posts and pages. The scoreboard seamlessly integrates with your theme’s design without breaking the layout.

Features

  • Easy Scoreboard Creation: Anyone can easily create and embed match scores for baseball and softball.
  • High Theme Compatibility: Background and text colors inherit your theme’s default styles.
  • Responsive Design: Designed to scroll horizontally on small screens when there are many innings.
  • Automatic Team Name Abbreviation: Automatically converts long team names into 1-2 letter abbreviations for better visibility.

Free Version Limitations

Please note that this free version has the following limitations:
* Create up to 5 scoreboards.
* Generate up to 2 shortcodes.
* Team Logo Image Support: NOT supported (Available only in the DX version).
* Default Innings: Fixed to 9 innings.
* Inning Adjustment: NOT supported.
* Language Switching: NOT supported (Japanese display only).
* Scoreboard Duplication: NOT supported.

If you need team logo support, flexible inning adjustment, unlimited scoreboard creation, and language switching, please consider upgrading to the DX version.
sections.installation:
1. Log into your WordPress dashboard and navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’.
  2. Click ‘Upload Plugin’, select the plugin zip file, and click ‘Install Now’.
  3. After installation, click ‘Activate Plugin’.
sections.faq:
I’m getting a 404 (Page Not Found) error

If you experience a 404 error with the custom post type permalinks, please try the following:
1. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘Permalinks’ in your dashboard.
2. Without making any changes, scroll down and click ‘Save Changes’ to flush the rewrite rules.

How can I create more than 5 scoreboards?

The free version allows up to 5 scoreboards. To create more, you can either delete older scoreboards or upgrade to the DX version for unlimited creation.
